messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: rattle _ 2.1.28. zip needed!
parts:
You should use the latest version of R, which is 2.5.1.

Follow the instructions at

http://datamining.togaware.com/survivor/Installing_GTK.html

focusing on the instructions for MS/Windows.

Thus you will:

1) Install the GTK+ libraries
2) Install R

Then get a copy of the required R packages to the computer and put
them into some folder, e.g., C:\Rpackages. This will include files
like RGtk2_2.10.11.zip, and many others, which are available, for
example, from

http://cran.at.r-project.org/bin/windows/contrib/r-release/

One simple approach is to grab everything in this folder and transfer
them across to your C:\Rpackages.

Then start up R, and from the menus select the option to install
packages from local folder (or something like that - I don't have a
windows machine in front of me at present). In the resulting window
that pops up browse to the C:\Rpackages folder, then select all of the
packages you would like to install, including rattle.

Hope that helps to get you started.

Regards,
Graham
